ranked_candidates.name: CompressionVolumeBreakout
ranked_candidates.primary_trigger: compressed volatility/compressed_range regime followed by completed-candle EMA20 directional break
ranked_candidates.hypothesis: Compression plus fresh volume can isolate real expansion better than funding-conditioned breakout variants.
ranked_candidates.why_different_from_failed_funding_event_: The event is price, volatility, liquidity, and market-beta structure; funding is not part of the trigger.
leakage_risks: entry must wait for row AvailableAtMS
width expansion must compare only current/prior completed rows
sample_size_risks: compression plus volume confirmation may be sparse in quiet months
likely_failure_modes: beta filter overfits broad trend days

ranked_candidates.name: RegimeTrendPullbackContinuation
ranked_candidates.primary_trigger: bull/bear trend regime with pullback toward EMA20 followed by Return5/Return15 resumption
ranked_candidates.hypothesis: Trend pullback continuation should have broad sample size and low leakage risk.
ranked_candidates.why_different_from_failed_funding_event_: Primary signal is trend structure and pullback recovery, not funding level or funding change.
leakage_risks: pullback definition must use completed current/prior rows only
sample_size_risks: strict pullback definitions may be sparse in persistent one-way moves

ranked_candidates.name: ShockFadeRegimeFiltered
ranked_candidates.primary_trigger: volatility shock after extreme Return5, faded only when trend/beta context does not confirm continuation
context_filters: prefer btc_flat or beta opposite the shock
ranked_candidates.hypothesis: Some shocks are transient overshoots even without liquidation data.
ranked_candidates.why_different_from_failed_funding_event_: Shock direction and regime context create the event; funding is excluded.
leakage_risks: shock label must be from current completed candle only
sample_size_risks: shock events may cluster in a few high-volatility months

ranked_candidates.name: BetaDivergenceReversion
ranked_candidates.primary_trigger: target Return5 diverges from BTC market beta while local trend is weak
confirmation_filters: avoid abnormal spike unless testing shock variant
ranked_candidates.hypothesis: Alt divergence from broad BTC direction may revert when local trend is weak.
ranked_candidates.why_different_from_failed_funding_event_: Cross-symbol price context drives the event.
leakage_risks: BTC/ETH context rows must be timestamp-aligned and as-of available
sample_size_risks: BTCUSDT cannot use itself as BTC context; ETH-linked assets may differ

ranked_candidates.name: VolumeMomentumContinuation
ranked_candidates.primary_trigger: heavy liquidity with Return5 and Return15 aligned
confirmation_filters: VolumeRatio20 heavy but below abnormal spike cap
ranked_candidates.hypothesis: Moderate volume expansion with aligned returns may continue before exhaustion.
ranked_candidates.why_different_from_failed_funding_event_: Candle liquidity and momentum are primary.
leakage_risks: do not assume true taker buy/sell join
sample_size_risks: loose filters can produce many weak events
likely_failure_modes: buying local tops after news spikes

ranked_candidates.name: ThinChopMeanReversion
ranked_candidates.primary_trigger: thin chop/range extension away from EMA20
confirmation_filters: predeclared small target and time stop
ranked_candidates.hypothesis: Small-target dead-zone chop candidates may prioritize low drawdown over gross expectancy.
ranked_candidates.why_different_from_failed_funding_event_: Risk-control-first microstructure regime, not derivative state.
leakage_risks: risk parameters must be predeclared before evaluation
sample_size_risks: edge may be too small after costs

ranked_candidates.name: UTCSessionWindowFilter
ranked_candidates.primary_trigger: predeclared UTC liquidity window used as context for another trigger
confirmation_filters: funding-time-adjacent behavior context only, never trigger
ranked_candidates.hypothesis: Time windows may reduce exposure to low-liquidity dead zones.
ranked_candidates.why_different_from_failed_funding_event_: Clock context is not funding state.
leakage_risks: window choice can overfit if selected after seeing returns
likely_failure_modes: calendar effects fail out of quarter

ranked_candidates.name: BasketDispersionLeadLag
ranked_candidates.primary_trigger: target lag/lead versus multi-symbol basket dispersion after BTC impulse
ranked_candidates.hypothesis: Lagging or leading alts may revert or continue depending on dispersion regime.
leakage_risks: high if basket rows are not strictly as-of aligned
sample_size_risks: needs synchronized complete rows across symbols
